summary: Implementation plan for VoxGuard Offline Android Translator: an on-device language identifier and real-time voice translator with Web Audio DSP noise filtering, Opus .ogg raw audio vault, three battery/background listening modes (Smart VAD, OLED Black-Screen Power Saver, and Scheduled/Manual), Live Headphone Interpreter with mic ducking/muting controls, and Android WebAPK + standalone APK packaging tools.
